artworks.title: Harlequin Duck
artworks.artist: Robert Havell after John James Audubon
artworks.medium: hand-colored engraving and aquatint on Whatman wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Walter B. James
artworks.description: This image depicts three ducks on a rocky shoreline in detailed illustration. The ducks are Harlequin Ducks shown in different poses. One duck is standing, displaying vibrant blue, black, and white plumage with orange accents. Another duck is perched on a rocky ledge seen from the side, showcasing detailed textured feathers. The third duck is resting on the ground with its brown plumage blending into the surroundings. The background is simple, hinting at a distant landscape and body of water, highlighting the ducks as the focal point. The style is reminiscent of John James Audubon's lifelike bird depictions.

artworks.title: Red-necked Grebe
artworks.artist: Robert Havell after John James Audubon
artworks.medium: hand-colored engraving and aquatint on Whatman wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Walter B. James
artworks.description: Two birds are depicted standing on a grassy patch by a body of water. One bird is leaning forward with its neck bent, while the other stands upright with sleek feathers pointed towards the water. Both birds have large webbed feet, and their plumage displays a mix of dark and light tones, with one bird featuring a red neck. The background shows a tranquil body of water bordered by cliffs, trees, and a partly cloudy sky in a style reminiscent of John James Audubon.

artworks.title: Dusky Petrel
artworks.artist: Robert Havell after John James Audubon
artworks.medium: hand-colored engraving and aquatint on Whatman wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Walter B. James
artworks.description: This is a painting of a bird swimming in the sea with cliffs in the background. The image depicts a dusky petrel floating on the water, with a distinct coloration pattern, sharp eye, and distinctive beak. Its feet are partially visible beneath the water, one leg extended showing webbed feet. The sea has gentle waves, and there are distant cliffs under a subtly colored sky.

artworks.title: Golden Plover
artworks.artist: Robert Havell after John James Audubon
artworks.medium: hand-colored engraving and aquatint on Whatman wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Walter B. James
artworks.description: This is a painting of three golden plovers in various poses. Two birds are on the ground, while one is in flight above them. The bird on the left has a golden-spotted plumage on its back, with a white and black pattern on its breast. The center bird is portrayed mid-flight with grey and gold markings visible on its wings. The bird on the right is crouching, wings partially unfolded. The background features a landscape with water bodies, hills, and a light sky. The style is reminiscent of John James Audubon, known for detailed and realistic avian illustrations.

artworks.title: Canvas-backed Duck
artworks.artist: Robert Havell after John James Audubon
artworks.medium: hand-colored engraving and aquatint on Whatman wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Walter B. James
artworks.description: This is a painting of three ducks by a lakeside with a cityscape in the background. The painting depicts three ducks. One duck is leaning down to drink from the lake, another stands on a rock, and a third duck is wading in the water. The background shows a distant city across the water under a subtly colored sky with fluffy clouds.

artworks.title: Dusky Duck
artworks.artist: Robert Havell after John James Audubon
artworks.medium: hand-colored engraving and aquatint on Whatman wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Walter B. James
artworks.description: The image shows two ducks near a grassy area. The ducks have detailed plumage with various earthy tones and a bright blue patch on their wings. One duck is sitting and the other is stretching its wings. The background features tall grasses.

artworks.title: Bartram Sandpiper
artworks.artist: Robert Havell after John James Audubon
artworks.medium: hand-colored engraving and aquatint on Whatman wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Walter B. James
artworks.description: This is a painting of two birds by the water with a plant in the background. The painting depicts two Bartram's sandpipers near the edge of a body of water. One bird is flying with wings outstretched, while the other is in a grounded position. Their feathers exhibit a pattern of browns, whites, and blacks. In the background, a green plant with broad leaves and a red bud is visible, rooted in rocky terrain. The water nearby is calm, reflecting hues of blue, and extends toward distant mountains under a soft sky. This painting is in the style of John James Audubon.

artworks.title: Turn-stone
artworks.artist: Robert Havell after John James Audubon
artworks.medium: hand-colored engraving and aquatint on Whatman wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Walter B. James
artworks.description: This is a painting of two turnstones - one in flight and one standing. The image shows the vibrant depiction of two turnstone birds, with one bird in mid-flight and the other standing on a sandy shore. The background features a serene landscape with calm water and distant mountains.

artworks.title: Purple Gallinule
artworks.artist: Robert Havell after John James Audubon
artworks.medium: hand-colored engraving and aquatint on Whatman wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Walter B. James
artworks.description: This is a painting of a purple gallinule walking on a riverside. The image shows a bird with blue feathers, a red forehead shield, and a yellow beak. It is walking on an earthy slope with grass nearby. In the background, there is a river, green foliage, trees, and a cloudy sky.

artworks.title: Great Northern Diver or Loon
artworks.artist: Robert Havell after John James Audubon
artworks.medium: hand-colored engraving and aquatint on Whatman wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Walter B. James
artworks.description: This is a painting of two birds by water. One bird is on the water and another is on land among foliage. In the foreground, there is a depiction of a Great Northern Diver, also known as a Loon. The bird on the right is positioned on land among tall stalks of grass, showcasing white and black speckled plumage and a vibrant blue-green head. The bird on the left is afloat on water with a sleek, grey and white body. Both birds have a sleek and elegant presence. Behind them, a body of water extends towards a distant mountainous landscape under a clear sky. This is in the style of John James Audubon.

artworks.title: Blue Crane or Heron
artworks.artist: Robert Havell after John James Audubon
artworks.medium: hand-colored engraving and aquatint on Whatman wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Walter B. James
artworks.description: This is a painting of a blue heron in a natural setting. The foreground shows a large blue heron standing on a rock near tall grass. The background features a water body bordered by grassy areas and a row of trees, suggesting a wetland or marsh environment. The painting uses colors to create a harmonious scene.

artworks.title: Tell-tale Godwit
artworks.artist: Robert Havell after John James Audubon
artworks.medium: hand-colored engraving and aquatint on Whatman wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Walter B. James
artworks.description: This is a painting of two shorebirds in a natural habitat. The painting depicts two shorebirds in a marshy environment. One bird is standing upright with its wings partially open, and the other bird is bending down. The birds are rendered with detailed plumage in shades of grays and browns, with vivid yellow legs. The background features a landscape with water, grasses, and trees under a softly hued sky.

artworks.title: Great Tern
artworks.artist: Robert Havell after John James Audubon
artworks.medium: hand-colored engraving and aquatint on Whatman wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Walter B. James
artworks.description: This is a painting of a Great Tern in mid-dive against a muted blue-gray background. The bird is captured with its wings outstretched and angled downward. The tern's body is primarily white and gray, with a distinctive black cap on its head. Its bill is bright red with a sharp black tip that curves slightly, and one of its feet is visible, displaying a bright red webbing. The details showcase the bird in a dynamic and graceful pose in the style of John James Audubon.

artworks.title: Spotted Sandpiper
artworks.artist: Robert Havell after John James Audubon
artworks.medium: hand-colored engraving and aquatint on Whatman wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Walter B. James
artworks.description: The image shows two spotted sandpipers near a small body of water, surrounded by a natural landscape. In the background, there is a high horizon with trees and a soft sky blending peachy pink with blues and greens. The painting features detailed brushstrokes for feathers and foliage, and broader strokes for water and sky, creating a harmonious composition with a natural and subdued color palette.

artworks.title: American White Pelican
artworks.artist: Robert Havell after John James Audubon
artworks.medium: hand-colored engraving and aquatint on Whatman wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Walter B. James
artworks.description: This is a detailed print of a white pelican standing at the edge of dark water, facing the left. The bird's wings are tucked in, and its large pouch rests on its long, thin neck. The pelican has mostly white feathers with some touches of pale yellow and some black feathers on the edges of its wings. There is a tuft of pale-yellow feathers behind its head, and its beak is yellow, with thin, dark veins crisscrossing its pouch. The pelican's feet are light yellow, and it stands on brown ground. In the background is a dark body of water with some dark trees in the distance, and the sky above is dark and cloudy.

artworks.title: Long-tailed Duck
artworks.artist: Robert Havell after John James Audubon
artworks.medium: hand-colored engraving and aquatint on Whatman wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Walter B. James
artworks.description: The image shows several long-tailed ducks. Two ducks are perched on rocks above the water, while three ducklings and one duck are swimming in the water. The ducks have a palette of browns, whites, and black with long tails. The largest duck stands on the left rock, angled towards the viewer, while the other adult duck is on the right rock. In the water below, one duck is swimming close to the center, followed by three ducklings. The background shows a calm sea and a pale sky.

artworks.title: Blue-winged Teal
artworks.artist: Robert Havell after John James Audubon
artworks.medium: hand-colored engraving and aquatint on Whatman wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Walter B. James
artworks.description: This is a painting of two blue-winged teals in flight. The artwork depicts two teal ducks gliding in the sky, with a background of a landscape featuring water and hills. Both ducks have blue patches on their wings, with one showing mottled brown and blue plumage, while the other has orange underbelly and a blue and white face pattern. Their bodies are elongated to suggest motion, and their feet are outstretched. The landscape has tones of green and slate. The style is reminiscent of John James Audubon, known for precise illustrations of birds.

artworks.title: Black-headed Gull
artworks.artist: Robert Havell after John James Audubon
artworks.medium: hand-colored engraving and aquatint on Whatman wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Walter B. James
artworks.description: This is a painting of two gulls. The painting depicts two birds, one with a black and white head and red legs in the foreground, while the other in the background is more subdued in color. The primary bird is perched with a forward gaze, showcasing its feathers with precise line work and shading. Both birds rest on an earthy surface.

artworks.title: Red-breasted Sandpiper
artworks.artist: Robert Havell after John James Audubon
artworks.medium: hand-colored engraving and aquatint on Whatman wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Walter B. James
artworks.description: This is a painting of two sandpipers on a rocky shoreline with water and mountains in the background. The artwork shows two birds prominently; the one in the foreground has a red-orange plumage on its breast, with patterns of brown, black, and white on its wings and back. Beside it is another bird with a color palette of grays and whites, both standing on a rock ledge jutting into calm water. The backdrop reveals a smooth horizon with mountains under a pale blue sky. It is in the style of John James Audubon, known for detailed depictions of birds. The painting exemplifies attention to detail and accurate representation of the birds’ physical characteristics in a serene natural setting.

artworks.title: Black-bellied Darter
artworks.artist: Robert Havell after John James Audubon
artworks.medium: hand-colored engraving and aquatint on Whatman wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Walter B. James
artworks.description: This is a painting of two birds perched on a tree stump by the water. The painting depicts a pair of waterfowl, identified as the Black-bellied Darter, scientifically known as Plotus Anhinga, standing atop a weathered tree trunk. One bird is perched higher than the other, with its wings outstretched, displaying intricate feather patterns in dark and light shades of black and grey. The other bird, sitting below, has a distinctive long neck, and its body is colored with rich brown and navy blue plumage. Its feet are bright yellow, gripping the bark of the trunk. In the background, there's a serene body of water with reflections of trees and a soft, peach-colored sky. This painting is reminiscent of John James Audubon's style, known for his detailed illustrations of birds.

artworks.title: Black or Surf Duck
artworks.artist: Robert Havell after John James Audubon
artworks.medium: hand-colored engraving and aquatint on Whatman wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Walter B. James
artworks.description: Two large ducks are depicted in a coastal setting. One duck is standing on a rock, while the other is on the sandy ground next to seashells. The ducks are primarily black and brown in color, with the background showing peach and blue tones. The duck on the left is on a rock, while the duck on the right is on the sandy shore.

artworks.title: American Avocet
artworks.artist: Robert Havell after John James Audubon
artworks.medium: hand-colored engraving and aquatint on Whatman wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Walter B. James
artworks.description: This is a painting of an American Avocet in its natural habitat. The scene features the bird foraging at the edge of a body of water, surrounded by greenery and rocks. The American Avocet is shown with its long legs, slender bill, and vibrant plumage. In the background, there are other birds near the water, with more visible further back. The setting includes lush foliage and calm water, creating a wetland atmosphere.

artworks.title: Lesser Tern
artworks.artist: Robert Havell after John James Audubon
artworks.medium: hand-colored engraving and aquatint on Whatman wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Walter B. James
artworks.description: This is a painting of two birds in flight against a dark background. The image depicts two terns with detailed feathering and graceful forms. One bird is in a downward gliding posture with folded wings, while the other bird has wings spread wide. The background is a dark, muted blue contrasting with the white tones of the terns.

artworks.title: Little Sandpiper
artworks.artist: Robert Havell after John James Audubon
artworks.medium: hand-colored engraving and aquatint on Whatman wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Walter B. James
artworks.description: The image shows two sandpipers near a stream, set against a backdrop of lush trees. The birds display detailed brown and white plumage as they stand by the water's edge. Trees obscure the horizon, and the stream winds its way from the background. The painting features precise brushstrokes, capturing the details of the birds and scenery. The color scheme includes earthy browns and greens for the vegetation, complemented by soft blue water and a pale, peachy sky.
